dependencies.basis: FCSC national accounts methodology and the IMF DSBB metadata for UAE national accounts both state that the System of National Accounts 2008 (or 1993 with 2008 amendments) is the framework used for compilation. Evidence: "The process of organizing national accounts takes into account the nature and peculiarity of the country in terms of its statistical system. ... statistical variables at the state level is based on the System of National Accounts, 1993 and its amendments in the 2008 system."
dependencies.evidence_quote: statistical variables at the state level is based on the System of National Accounts, 1993 and its amendments in the 2008 system

dependencies.basis: FCSC CPI methodology and IMF DSBB metadata state that the CPI basket and classification follow the UN Classification of Individual Consumption by Purpose (COICOP / COICOP-HBS). Evidence: "Price data is collected from about 250 major sources distributed across all the emirates in the country, where the data tab was considered according to the classification of individual consumption by purpose, issued by the United Nations COICOP, according to the recommendations of the 1993 System of National Accounts."
dependencies.evidence_quote: Price data is collected from about 250 major sources distributed across all the emirates in the country, where the data tab was considered according to the classification of individual consumption by purpose, issued by the United Nations COICOP, according to the recommendations of the 1993 System of National Accounts.

dependencies.basis: Central Bank of the UAE Balance of Payments developments publications explicitly state compilation according to BPM6. Evidence: "Balance of Payments (BOP) is statistical statement that is compiled in line with international recommendations, in particular the Sixth Edition of the Balance of Payments and International Investment Position Manual (BPM6) of the International Monetary Fund (IMF)."
dependencies.evidence_quote: Balance of Payments data for the UAE for the years 2023 and 2024 is presented according to the Sixth Edition of the International Monetary Fund Balance of Payments and International Investment Position Manual (BPM6).

dependencies.basis: Ministry of Finance GFS methodology guide states that UAE Government Finance Statistics Reports are prepared according to the IMF Government Finance Statistics Manual 2014. Evidence: "The United Arab Emirates Government Finance Statistics Reports are prepared according to the Government Finance Statistics Manual 2014 issued by the International Monetary Fund, which is in line with the concepts and terminology used in the System of National Accounts 2008 issued by the United Nations."
dependencies.evidence_quote: The UAE Government Finance Statistics Reports are prepared according to the Government Finance Statistics Manual 2014 issued by the International Monetary Fund, which is in line with the concepts and terminology used in the System of National Accounts 2008 issued by the United Nations.

dependencies.basis: Same MoF GFS guide explicitly aligns GFS concepts with SNA 2008. Evidence: "Terms and concepts are used by the Government Finance Statistics Manual (GFSM2014) and the System of National Accounts (SNA2008)."
dependencies.evidence_quote: The UAE Government Finance Statistics Reports are prepared according to the Government Finance Statistics Manual 2014 issued by the International Monetary Fund, which is in line with the concepts and terminology used in the System of National Accounts 2008 issued by the United Nations.

dependencies.basis: IMF DSBB metadata for UAE national accounts states that imports and exports data used in the accounts are taken from the balance of payments compiled by the Central Bank of the UAE. Evidence: "Imports and exports data are taken from the balance of payments compiled by the Central Bank of the U.A.E. (CBU); the CBU also supplies figures for banks."
dependencies.evidence_quote: Imports and exports data are taken from the balance of payments compiled by the Central Bank of the U.A.E. (CBU); the CBU also supplies figures for banks.

dependencies.basis: GASTAT Methodology and Quality Report for Annual National Accounts states the reference framework is the System of National Accounts 2008. Evidence: "The reference framework for national accounts statistics is the System of National Accounts 2008 (SNA2008)"
dependencies.evidence_quote: The reference framework for national accounts statistics is the System of National Accounts 2008 (SNA2008)

dependencies.basis: GASTAT CPI methodology and quality documentation and related FAQ state adoption of COICOP 2018 for the consumer basket classification and weight structure. Evidence: "The time series of the consumer price index was reconstructed starting from 2013 using the Classification of Individual Consumption According to Purpose (COICOP 2018) and the chain-linked methodology"
dependencies.evidence_quote: The time series of the consumer price index was reconstructed starting from 2013 using the Classification of Individual Consumption According to Purpose (COICOP 2018) and the chain-linked methodology

dependencies.basis: IMF SDDS DQAF metadata for Saudi Arabia balance of payments states that disseminated data conform to BPM6 and are presented in the standard BPM6 format. Evidence: "The disseminated data confirm broadly to the 6th edition of the IMF's Balance of Payments Manual (BPM6). ... BOP data are classified and presented in line with the BPM6 standard presentation format."
dependencies.evidence_quote: The disseminated data confirm broadly to the 6th edition of the IMF's Balance of Payments Manual (BPM6)

dependencies.basis: GASTAT Labor Market Statistics methodology and quality reports explicitly state that data on workers by economic activity and wages from the labour statistics are used as inputs in estimating national accounts. Evidence: "Data on workers by economic activity and wages are used as inputs in estimating national accounts."
dependencies.evidence_quote: Data on workers by economic activity and wages are used as inputs in estimating national accounts.

dependencies.basis: GASTAT Methodology and Quality Report for International Trade in Goods Statistics explicitly states that merchandise export and import statistics are compiled and classified according to the Harmonized System (HS 2022) issued by the World Customs Organization. Evidence: "The statistics of merchandise exports and imports of Saudi Arabia are compiled and classified in accordance with international standards. For classification purposes, these statistics rely on the Harmonized System (HS 2022) issued by the World Customs Organization (WCO), which is a nomenclature for the description and classification of goods that includes subheadings and their numerical codes, as well as sections and chapters."
dependencies.evidence_quote: These statistics are classified according to the Harmonized System (HS 2022) issued by the World Customs Organization (WCO).

dependencies.basis: GASTAT International Trade in Goods Statistics methodology notes that the series is aligned with national accounts frameworks and that trade data flows as accurate inputs within macroeconomic variables; customs data support measurement of imports and exports in the GDP comprehensive revision. Evidence: "International Trade in Goods Statistics is aligned with the frameworks of the national accounts and the balance of payments. This consistency is achieved through the harmonization of the concepts, definitions, and classifications used in recording exports and imports, ensuring that trade data flows as accurate and reliable inputs within macroeconomic variables."
dependencies.evidence_quote: In addition, the National Accounts Statistics Department at GASTAT benefits from the results of international trade in goods statistics.

dependencies.basis: GASTAT comprehensive revision methodology for GDP and national accounts lists the Harmonized System of Foreign Trade Classification (HS) among the main classifications used. Evidence: "Several statistical classifications have been used as follows: ... 5. Harmonized System of Foreign Trade Classification (HS)"
dependencies.evidence_quote: Several statistical classifications have been used as follows: ... Harmonized System of Foreign Trade Classification (HS)

dependencies.basis: FCSC national accounts methodology lists HS (Harmonized System of Foreign Trade) among the classifications applied in the compilation of national accounts. Evidence: "The main classifications relied upon in national accounts statistics include the following: ... HS (Harmonized System of Foreign Trade)"
dependencies.evidence_quote: Some classifications of activities, goods and services, exports, and imports: ... Harmonized System of Foreign Trade – HS

dependencies.basis: FCSC Methodology for National Accounts Statistics lists the Classification of economic activities in its latest version ISIC.4 as one of the main classifications applied. Evidence: "Some classifications of activities, goods and services, exports, and imports: Classification of economic activities in its latest version ISIC.4"
dependencies.evidence_quote: Some classifications of activities, goods and services, exports, and imports: Classification of economic activities in its latest version ISIC.4

dependencies.basis: GASTAT national accounts and GDP comprehensive revision methodology lists the International Standard Industrial Classification for the Economic Activities (ISIC4) as a main classification used for activities and value-added measurement. Evidence: "Several statistical classifications have been used as follows: 1. The International Standard Industrial Classification for the Economic Activities (ISIC4)"
dependencies.evidence_quote: Several statistical classifications have been used as follows: 1. The International Standard Industrial Classification for the Economic Activities (ISIC4)

dependencies.basis: IMF e-GDDS DQAF for UAE BOP states that bank-related data in the financial account are based on monetary and financial statistics of the UAE Central Bank (the Monthly Statistical Bulletin series). Evidence: "Banks: data are based on monetary and financial statistics (UAE Central Bank) on the external positions of the resident banks; flows are derived from stock changes."
dependencies.evidence_quote: Banks: data are based on monetary and financial statistics (UAE Central Bank) on the external positions of the resident banks; flows are derived from stock changes.

dependencies.basis: IMF e-GDDS DQAF for UAE BOP states that inward direct investment data are based on the annual foreign direct investment (FDI) survey carried out by the Federal Competitiveness and Statistics Authority (FCSC). Evidence: "Inward: data are based on the annual foreign direct investment (FDI) survey, from 2004 onwards, carried out by FCSA. The survey has national coverage..."
dependencies.evidence_quote: Inward: data are based on the annual foreign direct investment (FDI) survey, from 2004 onwards, carried out by FCSA.

dependencies.basis: FCSC national accounts methodology lists the Central Bank of the UAE among the primary data sources; the Central Bank supplies banking and related figures used in the accounts (consistent with the Monthly Statistical Bulletin series). Evidence: "Data Sources: National accounts are obtained from local statistical centers, the Ministry of Finance and the Central Bank."
dependencies.evidence_quote: Data Sources: National accounts are obtained from local statistical centers, the Ministry of Finance and the Central Bank.

dependencies.basis: GASTAT GDP comprehensive revision methodology lists Saudi Central Bank Balance of Payments data among the key administrative records used in national accounts and GDP compilation. Evidence: "Among the most important administrative records used in the National Accounts and compilation of Gross Domestic Product (GDP) are: a. Saudi Central bank: ▪ Balance of payment"
dependencies.evidence_quote: Among the most important administrative records used in the National Accounts and compilation of Gross Domestic Product (GDP) are: a. Saudi Central bank: - Balance of payment
